description: This Swift extension for CronJobEditor provides helper methods for managing and editing scheduled jobs, including parsing, building payloads, validation, and UI view components.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled label view with specified text.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Loads data from a job object into the editor's state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Builds the payload and triggers the save callback, handling errors.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing the job's payload, validating fields.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Creates a delivery configuration dictionary based on current UI state.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Returns a trimmed version of the provided string.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Validates that the name is non-empty, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Constructs schedule dictionary based on current schedule type and inputs.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload based on selected payload type.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Ensures session target and payload constraints are met.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Checks required fields within payloads, throws errors if missing.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Adds deleteAfterRun flag to the payload under certain schedule conditions.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Creates payload dictionary for agent turn type.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses a duration string into milliseconds.

methods.name: effectiveSessionTargetRaw
methods.description: Provides the effective raw session target value considering preserved state.

methods.name: isIsolatedLikeSessionTarget
methods.description: Determines if the session target is considered isolated.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats milliseconds into a concise duration string.
